name: pocketdev
description: Drive Claude Code on your Mac from your phone, and build and install iOS apps on your device without EAS, TestFlight, ngrok or a VPS.
//private: This is not an npm package, it is an app you clone and run. private=true prevents accidental publishing.

scripts.test: FILES=$(find test -name '*.test.ts' | sort); [ -n "$FILES" ] || { echo 'No test files found under test/' >&2; exit 1; }; node --import tsx --test $FILES
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run web:build && pm2 startOrRestart ecosystem.config.cjs
